children: Overview
Hong Kong baby products maker's interim revenue grew 5.8% yr/yr for six months ended June
Net income attributable to owners rose 161% yr/yr for the interim period
Operating profit and EPS surged, driven by improved profitability and cost management
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods
Result Drivers
HIGHER MARGINS - Gross profit increased 19.7% yr/yr primarily due to U.S. tariff refunds, while gross profit margin rose by 6.6 percentage points
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Operating profit rose 113.4% yr/yr, which the company attributed to underlying operating expenses being under control
